title: PLEASE FIX CONFIG_LIST
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/discussions/1163
Originally posted by **squatchydev9000** January 6, 2024 I have surrendered (for now) and will only be trying OAI models... no open-source drama for a while... HOWEVER - I CANNOT GET the OAI_CONFIG_LIST nonsesne to work... in any of the 4 formats you provide... Current headache: "[autogen.oai.client: 01-06 14:48:06] {80} WARNING - openai client was provided with an empty config_list, which may not be intended." The Config_List HAS to be your biggest issue/complaint with autogen....

linked_prs.title: support llm_config in AgentOptimizer
linked_prs.body:
<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please review https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/docs/Contribute before opening a pull request. -->

<!-- Please add a reviewer to the assignee section when you create a PR. If you don't have the access to it, we will shortly find a reviewer and assign them to your PR. -->

## Why are these changes needed?

<!-- Please give a short summary of the change and the problem this solves. -->
AgentOptimizer with OAI_CONFIG_LIST in its constructor is forcing users to learn the LLM config utilities. 
Taking llm_config as inout is more convenient for users.

## Related issue number

<!-- For example: "Closes #1234" -->
Closes #2279

ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**  
The issue is related to the configuration of the OpenAI client, which involves LLM provider usage and SDK parameters. The error message indicates a problem with the `OAI_CONFIG_LIST`, which is tied to LLM provider integration, making this an agent issue.
